name: Event Log (Lake Placid Blue)
inspiration: A developer-first site presented as an event-sourced system: the page is an append-only log, sections are projections, and opening one replays its events. The only guitar reference left is the accent — Fender Lake Placid Blue on a deep graphite stage.

display.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace
display.note: Large sentence-case mono headlines — terminal-native, not shouty

body.note: Clean carrier for decks and summaries

utility.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace

motion.note: Opening a section replays it: current projection compacts (lines collapse upward), then the new section's content streams in as log entries — kicker, headline, summary, items — each line sliding in with a blinking caret at the write head. A Ctrl+K command palette fuzzy-filters sections. Custom pointer: precise caret/crosshair dot with a lagging ring, morphing over interactive elements, magnetic pull on buttons, subtle glow trail.

params.offsetsAsMetadata: items get fake log offsets derived from JSON order
